```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5.5, fig.pos = "H"
)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(car)
library(broom)
library(patchwork)

NAVY <- "#011F5B"
RED  <- "#990000"
set.seed(42)
```

```{r load-data}
d_all <- read.csv("study_data_clean.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Manip-pass only (primary sample)
d <- d_all %>%
  filter(manip_correct == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    endorser_gender_f = factor(endorser_gender, levels = c("Male", "Female")),
    outcome_f = factor(outcome, levels = c("Failure", "Success")),
    strength_f = factor(strength_cond, levels = c("weak", "strong")),
    trust_change = as.numeric(trust_change),
    p_female = ifelse(participant_gender == "Female", 1, 0)
  )

N <- nrow(d)
```

\newpage

# Trust Change Summary

```{r no-change-table}
no_change <- d %>%
  group_by(`Endorser Gender` = endorser_gender, Strength = strength_cond, Outcome = outcome) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    `No Change` = sum(trust_change == 0),
    `% No Change` = sprintf("%.1f%%", mean(trust_change == 0) * 100),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

overall <- tibble(
  `Endorser Gender` = "Overall",
  Strength = "",
  Outcome = "",
  N = nrow(d),
  `No Change` = sum(d$trust_change == 0),
  `% No Change` = sprintf("%.1f%%", mean(d$trust_change == 0) * 100)
)

bind_rows(no_change, overall) %>%
  kable(caption = sprintf("No-change responses (D2 = D1) by condition (N = %d)", N), booktabs = TRUE)
```

\newpage

# RQ1: Gender $\times$ Outcome on Trust Change

$$\text{TrustChange}_i = \beta_0 + \beta_1\text{Female} + \beta_2\text{Success} + \beta_3(\text{Female} \times \text{Success}) + \beta_4\Delta_{Q2} + \beta_5\text{PGender} + \varepsilon_i$$

Controls: Q2 display strength delta, participant gender.

```{r rq1-fig, fig.height=5.5, fig.width=8, fig.cap="RQ1: Gender x Outcome on Trust Change"}
pd <- d %>%
  group_by(endorser_gender_f, outcome_f) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(trust_change), se = sd(trust_change) / sqrt(n()),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    ci_hi = m + 1.96 * se, ci_lo = m - 1.96 * se,
    label_y = ifelse(m >= 0, ci_hi + 1.5, ci_lo - 1.5),
    label_vjust = ifelse(m >= 0, 0, 1)
  )

ggplot(pd, aes(x = outcome_f, y = m, fill = endorser_gender_f)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi),
                position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.25) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_text(aes(y = label_y, label = sprintf("%.1f\n(n=%d)", m, n),
                vjust = label_vjust),
            position = position_dodge(0.8), size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Male" = NAVY, "Female" = RED)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(pd$ci_lo) - 8, max(pd$ci_hi) + 8)) +
  labs(title = sprintf("RQ1: Gender x Outcome (N = %d)", N),
       x = "Outcome", y = "Trust Change (D2 - D1)", fill = "Endorser Gender") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

\newpage

```{r rq1-reg, results='markup'}
m1 <- lm(trust_change ~ endorser_gender_f * outcome_f + q2_variance_delta + p_female, data = d)
summary(m1)
```

```{r rq1-summary}
# Cell means table
d %>%
  group_by(`Endorser Gender` = endorser_gender, Outcome = outcome) %>%
  summarise(N = n(), Mean = mean(trust_change), SD = sd(trust_change),
            SE = sd(trust_change)/sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(digits = 1, caption = "RQ1: Cell means", booktabs = TRUE)
```

\newpage

# RQ2: Gender $\times$ Strength $\times$ Outcome

## Combined Figure

```{r rq2-combined, fig.height=5.5, fig.width=12, fig.cap="RQ2: Gender x Outcome split by Endorser Strength"}
pd_both <- d %>%
  group_by(endorser_gender_f, outcome_f, strength_f) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(trust_change), se = sd(trust_change) / sqrt(n()),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    ci_hi = m + 1.96 * se, ci_lo = m - 1.96 * se,
    label_y = ifelse(m >= 0, ci_hi + 1.5, ci_lo - 1.5),
    label_vjust = ifelse(m >= 0, 0, 1)
  )

ggplot(pd_both, aes(x = outcome_f, y = m, fill = endorser_gender_f)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi),
                position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.25) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_text(aes(y = label_y, label = sprintf("%.1f (n=%d)", m, n),
                vjust = label_vjust),
            position = position_dodge(0.8), size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  facet_wrap(~ strength_f, nrow = 1,
             labeller = labeller(strength_f = c("weak" = "Weak Endorser",
                                                 "strong" = "Strong Endorser"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Male" = NAVY, "Female" = RED)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(pd_both$ci_lo) - 8, max(pd_both$ci_hi) + 8)) +
  labs(title = sprintf("RQ2: Gender x Outcome by Strength (N = %d)", N),
       x = "Outcome", y = "Trust Change (D2 - D1)", fill = "Endorser Gender") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"))
```

## Full Three-Way Model

```{r rq2-3way-reg, results='markup'}
m2 <- lm(trust_change ~ endorser_gender_f * strength_f * outcome_f +
           q2_variance_delta + p_female, data = d)
summary(m2)
```

\newpage

## RQ2a: Strong Endorsers

```{r rq2a-fig, fig.height=5.5, fig.width=8, fig.cap="RQ2a: Strong Endorsers — Gender x Outcome"}
d_strong <- d %>% filter(strength_cond == "strong")

pd_s <- d_strong %>%
  group_by(endorser_gender_f, outcome_f) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(trust_change), se = sd(trust_change) / sqrt(n()),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    ci_hi = m + 1.96 * se, ci_lo = m - 1.96 * se,
    label_y = ifelse(m >= 0, ci_hi + 1.5, ci_lo - 1.5),
    label_vjust = ifelse(m >= 0, 0, 1)
  )

ggplot(pd_s, aes(x = outcome_f, y = m, fill = endorser_gender_f)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi),
                position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.25) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_text(aes(y = label_y, label = sprintf("%.1f\n(n=%d)", m, n),
                vjust = label_vjust),
            position = position_dodge(0.8), size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Male" = NAVY, "Female" = RED)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(pd_s$ci_lo) - 8, max(pd_s$ci_hi) + 8)) +
  labs(title = sprintf("RQ2a: Strong Endorsers — Gender x Outcome (N = %d)", nrow(d_strong)),
       x = "Outcome", y = "Trust Change (D2 - D1)", fill = "Endorser Gender") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r rq2a-reg, results='markup'}
m3 <- lm(trust_change ~ endorser_gender_f * outcome_f + q2_variance_delta + p_female,
          data = d_strong)
summary(m3)
```

# RQ3: Initial Trust by Gender $\times$ Strength

$$\text{D1 Wager}_i = \beta_0 + \beta_1\text{Female} + \beta_2\text{Strong} + \beta_3(\text{Female} \times \text{Strong}) + \varepsilon_i$$

```{r rq3-fig, fig.height=5.5, fig.width=8, fig.cap="RQ3: Initial Trust by Gender x Strength"}
pd3 <- d %>%
  group_by(endorser_gender_f, strength_f) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(trust_d1), se = sd(trust_d1) / sqrt(n()),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(ci_hi = m + 1.96 * se, ci_lo = m - 1.96 * se)

ggplot(pd3, aes(x = strength_f, y = m, fill = endorser_gender_f)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi),
                position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.25) +
  geom_text(aes(y = ci_hi + 1, label = sprintf("%.1f\n(n=%d)", m, n)),
            position = position_dodge(0.8), vjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Male" = NAVY, "Female" = RED)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("weak" = "Weak Endorser", "strong" = "Strong Endorser")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(pd3$ci_hi) + 10)) +
  labs(title = sprintf("RQ3: Initial Trust (D1 Wager) by Gender x Strength (N = %d)", N),
       x = "Endorsement Strength", y = "Initial Wager (D1)", fill = "Endorser Gender") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r rq3-reg, results='markup'}
m5 <- lm(trust_d1 ~ endorser_gender_f * strength_f, data = d)
summary(m5)
```
